description: Defines the AddressSorterPosix class for sorting IP addresses based on policies, including nested structs and enums, and implements network change observation.

classes.name: AddressSorterPosix
classes.description: Implements address sorting policy for POSIX systems, observing network changes and managing address preferences.

methods.name: Sort
methods.description: Sorts a list of IP endpoints based on policy and network conditions.

methods.description: Callback invoked when the IP address changes, to update internal state.

methods.name: FinishedSort
methods.description: Completes the sorting process for a given context.
